payout_quote: It's free to sign up and bid on jobs
steps: Sign up for a free Freelancer.com account and build a profile with skills, experience, and portfolio samples.
Browse publicly posted projects (fixed-price and hourly) and place free bids with your price, timeframe, and proposal.
Win bids by competing on price, profile strength, and reviews; the client awards the project.
Complete the work and get paid through Freelancer's Milestone Payment system; a per-project service fee applies.
catches: Free accounts get a limited monthly bid allocation — serious bidding beyond that needs a paid membership (not required to start).
Bidding is competitive; most bids lose and earn nothing.
Project budgets are set by clients; Freelancer publishes no fixed freelancer pay range.
A service fee applies per project/award; check the official fee schedule at signup before bidding.
Identity/KYC verification is required before withdrawing funds.
biggest_catch: Most bids lose, and free accounts get only a limited number of bids per month — earnings depend entirely on winning client work.
eligibility: Anyone who can create a free account and legally freelance in their jurisdiction; skills must match posted projects.
timing: Projects post continuously; payouts on project completion via milestones.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: free signup, profile, bid on posted projects, win award, milestone payment.

c4.evidence: Signup and bidding on the free account are free; paid memberships are optional upgrades, not required to bid.
